notes: Unlike sheet 42 this sheet is drawn square to the page (very slight rotation: 8th faces drop ~20 px from John to Central). Jogs at Central Avenue: West 8th is 60' west of Central (centre y~1205 at John, ~1183 at Central) and 53' east of it with its centre ~246 px further north (y~937), so it is two T junctions on Central; the east part is named 'West 8th Street (east of Central)'. West 7th is 60' west of Central and 66' east (south face steps out), point at the middle of the four corners. George is 40' west of Central (centre 3056) and 50' east (centre 3074); one crossing at the corner midpoint. West 6th is 66' west of Central (faces 3694/3925, centre ~3812) and 120' from Central to Plum and beyond (faces 3506/3925, centre 3716), with a market house (block 29) standing in the middle of the street between Central and Plum (40' roadway north of it, 45' south); the south face is continuous. Central/6th is therefore taken at the middle of the four block corners (2068,3762), about 50 px off each centreline; Plum/6th and Wood Alley/6th use the 120' centreline (y~3716), which lies inside the market house outline. John jogs at 7th exactly as on sheet 42: John north of 7th centre x~467-470, John south of 7th centre x~652-659 (both 40'), recorded as two T junctions; the southern line is named 'John Street (south of 7th)' to match sheet 42. L'Hommedieu (printed L'HOMMEDIEU, 20') runs from sheet 42 across John to Central (T). East of Central an alley printed only 'ALLEY' (12') runs Central to Plum, offset ~44 px south (centre 2684); sheet 44 prints the continuation east of Plum as L'HOMMEDIEU ALLEY, so it is named 'L'Hommedieu Alley (Central to Plum)'. East of Plum the L'Hommedieu gap is at y~2735-2777 (centre 2756), offset again, recorded as its own T on Plum and named 'L'Hommedieu Alley (Plum to Elm)' to match sheet 44. Wood Alley (printed WOOD ALLEY, 12') runs from the Central-Plum alley across George to West 6th; south of George it is unnamed but on the same line (12' printed at 6th). Cathedral Alley printed 'CATHEDRA(L) ... ALLEY', 10', Central to Plum, T at both ends. Central centre from faces 1967/2165 and pipes 2037/2097; Plum centre from faces 3516/3748.
